instructions: This memory is for operating pelletd, a small metrics relay daemon that a dashboard scrapes. Future sessions need the current config location, port and authentication method, exact commands and flags, and they must be able to tell which older values are no longer valid.
description: Drift scenario: config location, port and auth method each change twice across eight sessions (2026-01-12 to 2026-04-20). Only the latest value is true; every superseded value that is still mentioned must carry a date or a superseded/no longer marker. Patterns are JavaScript regexes tested per document, case-insensitive.

checks.description: The current config file /opt/pelletd/conf.d/relay.toml is documented
The current port 9443 is documented as the listen port
The current auth method (bearer tokens) is documented
The command that issues tokens, `pelletd token issue`, is recorded
/etc/pelletd/pelletd.conf (config location until 1.2.0) appears only with a date or superseded/no longer marker
~/.config/pelletd/config.yaml (config location 1.2.0 to 1.4.x) appears only with a date or superseded/no longer marker
Port 9100 (until 2026-02-23) appears only with a date or superseded/no longer marker
Port 9115 (2026-02-23 to 2026-04-05) appears only with a date or superseded/no longer marker
The static key (X-Pellet-Key) appears only with a date or superseded/no longer marker
Basic auth (users.htpasswd, 2026-03-09 to 2.1.0) appears only with a date or superseded/no longer marker
The date of the latest change (2026-04-20 or the release date 2026-04-19) is recorded
Exact flag `--buffer 4096` (found in a dry run) is recorded
The pre-restart command `pelletd validate` is recorded
/_index.md exists and links every non-stub document
Every [[link]] resolves to an existing document

questions.question: In the latest pelletd release, which file does the daemon read its configuration from? Reply with only the current path.
Which TCP port does pelletd listen on now? Reply with only the port number.
How do clients authenticate to pelletd in the latest release? Reply in one short sentence with the current method only.
Which command issues a credential for a client, and with which flag is the lifetime set?
Which flag sets the ring buffer size of the relay, and which value fixed the dropped samples?
What is the latest pelletd version recorded in the notes? Reply with only the version.
